title: Pharmacological targeting of NR4A1 restrains lipid metabolism-ferroptosis axis in UVR-induced skin aging.
authors: Wang, Hongjin; Li, Jingjing; Xu, Xiaogang; Zeng, Yixi; Shi, Guofeng; Zhang, Lanyue; Zheng, Junxia; Li, Hui
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NR4A1调控脂代谢-铁死亡轴在紫外线致皮肤老化中的作用，虽涉及ChIP-seq和分子动力学模拟，但核心是药理学靶向与表型机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Skin photo-aging induced by ultraviolet radiation (UVR) leads to aesthetic alterations, structural degradation, and loss of barrier function. Ferroptosis has been implicated upon UVR stress but the driving modifiers remain largely undefined. Naringin has been reported to exert protective effects against UVR damage, however, the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. PURPOSE: To explore the driving factors of UVR-induced ferroptosis and to comprehensively evaluate the effects and underlying mechanisms of naringin in repressing UVR-induced photo-aging. METHODS: A mouse model in which the dorsal skin, as well as a cell model using HaCaT keratinocytes, were exposed to UVR to simulate daily sun exposure. Lentivirus-mediated knockdown, ChIP-seq, and RNA-seq analysis were used to evaluate the role of NR4A1 in UVR-induced ferroptosis. RNA-seq and metabonomics were performed to elucidate the underlying mechanisms of naringin against photo-aging. Molecular dynamics simulations/DARTS/CETSA, and co-IP assays were employed to investigate the mechanism by which naringin regulates NR4A1 expression. RESULTS: Reduction of NR4A1 leads to excessive lipid metabolism and initiates ferroptosis in UVR-induced photo-aging. Naringin directly binds to NR4A1, enhancing its stability by preventing ubiquitin-mediated degradation, transcriptionally represses EGR1 and LDLR expression, thereby suppressing lipid peroxidation and ferroptotic damage. Remarkably, both genetic deficiency and pharmacological inhibition of NR4A1 across diverse models abolish the effects of naringin against photo-aging. CONCLUSION: Our findings emphasize the critical role of NR4A1 in ferroptosis driven by dysregulated lipid metabolism and reveal the therapeutic potential of targeting NR4A1 with naringin in UVR-induced photo-aging, as well as in the other relevant lipid metabolism dysfunction disorders.
abstract_zh: 背景：紫外线辐射（UVR）诱导的皮肤光老化导致美学改变、结构退化和屏障功能丧失。铁死亡（ferroptosis）已被涉及在UVR应激中，但其驱动修饰因子在很大程度上仍不明确。柚皮苷（naringin）已被报道对UVR损伤具有保护作用，然而其潜在机制尚未完全阐明。目的：探讨UVR诱导铁死亡的驱动因素，并全面评估柚皮苷抑制UVR诱导光老化的效果及其潜在机制。方法：建立小鼠模型，暴露背部皮肤，以及使用HaCaT角质形成细胞的细胞模型，模拟日常阳光暴露。使用慢病毒介导的敲低、ChIP-seq和RNA-seq分析评估NR4A1在UVR诱导铁死亡中的作用。进行RNA-seq和代谢组学分析以阐明柚皮苷抗光老化的潜在机制。采用分子动力学模拟/DARTS/CETSA和co-IP实验研究柚皮苷调控NR4A1表达的机制。结果：NR4A1的减少导致脂质代谢过度，并在UVR诱导的光老化中启动铁死亡。柚皮苷直接结合NR4A1，通过防止泛素介导的降解增强其稳定性，转录抑制EGR1和LDLR表达，从而抑制脂质过氧化和铁死亡损伤。值得注意的是，在不同模型中，NR4A1的遗传缺陷和药理学抑制均消除了柚皮苷抗光老化的效果。结论：我们的发现强调了NR4A1在脂质代谢失调驱动的铁死亡中的关键作用，并揭示了以柚皮苷靶向NR4A1在UVR诱导光老化及其他相关脂质代谢功能障碍疾病中的治疗潜力。
